BOUNDED OPERATIONAL INTELLIGENCE — the enforced boundaries
· Permission modes (READ_ONLY · PLAN_ONLY · APPROVAL_REQUIRED · AUTONOMOUS) evaluated per action — modes change gates, never tools
· Budgets halt the loop at safe boundaries: tokens · dollars · iterations · tool calls · runtime · mutations — one grace call, honest partial, resumable
· Mutations exit only through: proposal (data) → compile closures → approval (hash-bound, four-eyes in prod) → deterministic execution → evidence-backed verification
· Every run is durable and replayable (run_events) · resumable on any worker · cancel at boundaries, never mid-apply · trace == run · redaction on every egress
· Hardline deny tier no approval can unlock · ESTOP pauses new work, never in-flight applies · subagent output is untrusted evidence · skills change only via PR + eval gate
Source of truth: Mermaid in Redesign/02-Redesigned-Architecture.md §2.1 — this render is content-identical, laid out for presentation.
